headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep line-height tight (leading-none or leading-tight). Max hero text size is text-5xl.

body.rules: Use for all functional text, inputs, buttons, and descriptions.

background.description: Bone White. Used for the main app background to give an organic, warm feel.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and floating elements to pop against the bone white background.

primary.description: Terracotta/Rust. Triggers appetite. Used for primary CTAs (Add to Cart, Accept Order), active states, and alert indicators.

secondary.description: Deep Forest Green. Used for primary text, elegant contrast, and success states (Order Ready).

customer_menu.layout: Mobile-first. Fixed top glassmorphism header with category tabs (horizontal scroll). Sticky bottom cart summary button.
customer_menu.item_card: Vertical layout. Large top image (max-h-48, object-cover, rounded-t-2xl), pure white body, crisp typography. 'Add' button in Terracotta.
customer_menu.category_tabs: Pill-shaped tabs. Active tab gets bg-primary text-white. Inactive is bg-white text-secondary.

cashier_dashboard.layout: Tablet-optimized High-Density Bento Grid. Sidebar navigation (fixed, dark theme #2E3D36). Main content area uses bone-white background.
cashier_dashboard.order_board: Kanban style or Dense List. Status colors: New (Terracotta), Preparing (Amber), Ready (Forest Green).
cashier_dashboard.cards: Flat solid surfaces with 1px border. No heavy shadows to prevent visual fatigue.

owner_dashboard.layout: Standard web layout. Top metrics (Sales, Orders). Data tables for menu management and staff.
owner_dashboard.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Keep charts minimalistic without grid lines.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8 for containers. Gap-4 to gap-8 for grids.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text for readability, center-align empty states.
layouts.rtl_support: CRITICAL: The app must support Arabic (RTL). Use logical properties: me-* (margin-inline-end), ms-* (margin-inline-start), ps-*, pe-*, text-start, text-end instead of left/right.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards. Button scale down (active:scale-95).
motion.list_items: Staggered fade-in for menu items and incoming orders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Terracotta meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors should be dark charcoal.
accessibility.targets: Minimum 48x48px tap targets for mobile menus and cashier dashboard buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

images.description: Gourmet vegan burger on dark background. Use for hero menu item or promotions.
Burger and fries on a plate. Use for main menu item card.
Iced latte in clear glass. Use for drinks category.
Spacious modern restaurant interior. Use for owner login screen background or dashboard empty states.
Chef cooking in modern kitchen. Use for 'Preparing' state illustrations or staff management sections.

libraries_and_tools.toast: sonner for all notifications (e.g., 'Order placed', 'New order received').
libraries_and_tools.animations: framer-motion for page transitions and micro-interactions.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with custom colors (bone-white, terracotta, forest green) and fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi).
2. Build the app using .js and .jsx files (not .tsx as instructed).
3. Scaffold three main layout routes: /menu (Mobile QR view), /cashier (Tablet POS view), and /admin (Desktop owner view).
4. Prioritize the mobile /menu route. Implement sticky category headers, horizontal scrolling tabs, and a floating 'View Cart' CTA at the bottom.
5. For the /cashier route, use a dense grid to display live orders. Color-code orders by status.
6. Use RTL-friendly Tailwind classes (pe-*, ps-*, text-start) everywhere to ensure the Arabic language toggle works seamlessly without layout breaks.
7. Mock WebSocket data using a React Context or a custom hook with intervals to simulate live order status updates.
8. Format all prices in IDR (Rp) by default.
9. Add data-testid to all buttons and inputs.
10. Do not use generic centered layouts. Maintain high contrast. Use sonner for notifications.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
Do NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do NOT center align the app container. Preserve natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or rounded-xl with hover scales.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
